Classification: Low Clan

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} feel Caine's curse most painfully: upon Embrace, tainted blood remakes each into a hideous, deformed horror over the course of up to a week, a change so severe that some go mad and must be destroyed by their own sires. Clan founder Absimiliard is said to have been cursed with the loss of that which he held dearest — his beauty, or his lover, or both — and to have turned his rage upon his own childer ever after. Out of necessity, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} (called Lepers) have become masters of hiding, deception, and subterfuge, gathering information the High Clans quietly depend on even as they scorn the clan openly.

Disciplines: Animalism, Obfuscate, Potence

Advantage: All Nosferatu gain at least one Trait of Stealth at no cost, and one Ability Trait of Survival.

Disadvantage: No Nosferatu may possess the Social Traits Alluring, Gorgeous or Seductive (without powers such as Obfuscate), and they suffer the Negative Social Traits Repugnant x3 (which can never be removed) whenever their true form is apparent. A Nosferatu cannot initiate Social Challenges except for intimidation.

Organization: Small, concealed groups hidden from other Cainites, dwelling among the diseased, the fallen, and the forgotten corners of society.

Suggested Viae: Beast, Heaven, Sin.
